contests.title: PayPal AI Hackathon
contests.description: About the challenge PayPal already moves money for millions of people and businesses, every day, all over the world. This hackathon is us opening that platform up and asking what happens when you put AI behind the wheel. New agents, new ways to pay and get paid, tools nobody's built yet. We want to see what you make of it. AI is changing how people build, buy, sell, work, connect, and move money. Now it's your turn to imagine what comes next. Build What's Next with PayPal and AI is a global online hackathon inviting developers, designers, founders, students, and builders to create something new using PayPal and AI. There are no prescribed problem statements and no set of tracks. Build an agent, an app, an automation, a new payment experience, a business tool, a social product, or something we haven't thought of yet. The only fundamental requirement: your project must meaningfully use both PayPal and AI. Why Join? Build something ambitious — Turn an idea into a working project using PayPal and AI. Explore what’s next — Experiment with new ways people, businesses, and AI agents can interact with money and payments. Win part of $69,750 in total prizes — Compete for overall prizes and special awards across creativity, impact, execution, and more. Show what you can build — Put your project in front of PayPal judges, developers, and the wider hackathon community. Learn by building — Explore PayPal APIs, AI tools, agents, automations, and emerging development workflows. Build your way — Join individually or as a team, and start something new or meaningfully advance an existing project. Get started Get a PayPal Developer account (5 minutes) Review example projects and brainstorm your own (30 minutes) Webinars Oct 6th 9am PT - 9:45am PT ~ Start building with PayPal Recording Oct 7th 9am PT - 9:30am PT ~ Power Your PayPal Hackathon Project with APIMatic Context Plugins Oct 12th 7am PT - 7:45am PT ~ Build a payments dashboard without building a dashboard Oct 13th 1am PT - 2am PT ~ Start building with PayPal

That's the problem Atlassian is built to solve. And it's the problem we're inviting you to tackle. Build an app on Atlassian’s Forge platform that uses that context to help teams ship with confidence – whether that’s surfacing the right knowledge at the right moment, connecting work across silos, or turning organizational data into a decision that actually moves work forward. Join the live Build Session Tue, Nov 17, 12:00 to 12:45 PM ET on Zoom. Danny Thompson, Senior Developer Advocate at Atlassian, and Adam Moore, Group Product Manager, Forge, show how to build AI workflows with Atlassian Forge and Rovo, followed by live Q&A. Set up Forge first and you can build along. The recording will be on YouTube afterward. Register for the Build Session

contests.description: UGREEN is opening AI NAS to developers through UGOS and Skills Hub. Powered by UGOS, UGREEN's own Linux-based operating system, UGREEN AI NAS brings local storage, computing, and AI capabilities together in one platform. Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Linux and Docker, AI agent and tool design, and file or media processing are all useful here. Why Participate 💰 Compete for $46,000 in cash prizes. Five winners will share the prize pool, including two Most Creative awards. 🚀 No NAS needed to start. Round 1 is open to everyone. You only need your idea, the Skill Developer Package, and your code. 🖥️ Test on real hardware for free. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro. 🎨 Build what you care about. Choose from four tracks: work automation, personal memories, creative media, or your own original idea. 🤝 Connect with the UGREEN team. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations.

contests.title: Learn AR with SPECS
contests.description: Design an augmented reality app for glasses, and let an AI coding agent build it in Lens Studio. You don't need the glasses, because everything runs in Lens Studio's preview on your laptop. You'll get a short concept video, a skill pack for your coding agent, a live build session, and a live project review. $2,500 in prizes each round. ABOUT THE CHALLENGE Screens won't be the only place we use computers. Glasses are coming, and building for them is different from building for a laptop or a phone. Most first tries at AR end up as a website floating in front of your face. Good AR does things a laptop can't do: It shares your view. The camera sees what you see, so the app can respond to it. It draws in the world. Content sits on the table, over the stove, at real size, right where it belongs. It leaves your body free. Your hands stay available and your eyes stay up, so you can keep doing the real thing. Coding agents can now build a working Lens from a good description. So the hard part is deciding what's worth building and how it should feel. That's what this hackathon teaches. You'll install our Devpost Learn skill pack in your coding agent. It interviews you about your idea, checks it against AR design best practices, and writes a design brief. Then Snap's CLAD agents build the Lens in Lens Studio from that brief, and you try it in the preview. You'll finish with a working Lens, the plan behind it, and a way of thinking about AR you can use on every project after this one. WHY JOIN Learn what makes a good AR app, from the design decisions an agent can't make for you. Build for SPECS, Snap's AR glasses, without owning a pair. Try Snap's newest agent tools: CLAD, the Lens Studio MCP, and LEAF testing. Get help from real people in a live build session and a live project review. Compete to win a share of $2,500. First place takes $1,250, and every winner gets a feature in the Devpost newsletter and on Devpost's socials. Everyone who submits an eligible project gets a Devpost Learn badge and a special role in the Devpost Discord. GET STARTED You'll need a computer that runs Lens Studio, Node.js and Git, and a coding agent that supports skills. Set up your tools with the quick start on the Resources tab: your coding agent, Lens Studio, the Lens Studio MCP, and the CLAD plugin. Can't sign in to the developer platform on Lens Studio 5.24? Use Lens Studio 5.23.2 instead. Watch the concept video (at the top of this page). It's short, and it covers the design ideas the judges look for. Install the skill pack: npx skills add challengepost/learn-specs --all -y. Then open your coding agent and say "Run the plan-lens skill." It takes it from there. Join the SPECS channel in the Devpost Discord for questions and to see what other builders are making. Register for the Build for SPECS: AR Design with Lens Studio and CLAD live build session on Thursday, Oct 29 at 12PM ET. We build a Lens start to finish. It's recorded if you can't make it. Come to the SPECS Live Review: Inside the Judging Criteria on Thursday, Nov 5 at 12PM ET. We review a few projects in progress against the judging criteria, so you still have time to act on the feedback before the deadline. Want yours reviewed live? Post it in the #devpost-learn-feedback channel in the Discord and tag it "Learn AR with SPECS" and "Will It Ship." Stuck? Ask in the Discord channel. Setup help, the FAQ, and event details are on the Resources tab.

contests.title: QNX Global Hackathon
contests.description: For decades, QNX has been running the systems people bet their lives on, from medical devices and factory floors to trains, robots, and more than 275 million vehicles. It guarantees not just that your code runs, but exactly when. Now QNX 8.0 is free for non-commercial use, and the QNX team wants to see what you do with it when nobody hands you a spec. Build a robot that reacts in microseconds instead of milliseconds. Write the driver nobody has written yet. Port something you love to QNX, or build the tooling you always wished existed. If it runs on QNX 8.0, or helps someone else build for it, it counts. Pick your category and compete for a share of $50,000. Show us what you can do! Why join? Get your hands on a real-time OS, free. QNX Everywhere gives you QNX SDP 8.0, QNX Developer Desktop, and the QNX Hypervisor for non-commercial use, plus free training courses to get you moving. No target hardware required; QEMU works, and so does a Raspberry Pi 5. In 275 million vehicles. Now on your laptop. Not a teaching edition or a stripped-down trial. It's the same QNX that ships in commercial systems, and until QNX Everywhere, building on it meant a commercial license. Compete for $50,000 in prizes. Plus swag, a coffee chat with a QNX exec, and a feature on the QNX blog and social channels. Get Started Get free access to QNX SDP 8.0 through QNX Everywhere (5 minutes) Run through the QNX SDP 8.0 Quick Start Guide and get a program running on your target or QEMU (45 minutes) Browse QNX sample projects and open-source ports, then pick your category (30 minutes)

contests.description: DSH Hacks V2 is a global student competition open to students aged 13+ hosted collaboratively by three youth-led organizations: DeltaForge Hacks, NXT Horizon, and STEMise. Theme: AI x Healthcare This event brings together young innovators from around the world to transform bold ideas into technical products that address the health challenges facing our world today. Participants will work individually or in teams to identify a real-world healthcare problem and design and develop a meaningful technical solution. Projects may range from diagnostic tools tackling global disease burdens, to patient-care platforms improving access and outcomes, to AI-powered systems reimagining how we detect, treat, and manage illness. Creativity, feasibility, technical depth, clinical insight, and real-world impact will be central to evaluation. The theme of this competition is to build technical solutions that solve pressing healthcare problems. These solutions can be an app, a website, a simulation, a system, or an algorithm. Participants are encouraged to use AI to help them build a meaningful solution and to lower the technical barrier that poses challenges for beginners with ambitious project ideas.

Pick Your Track: Review the examples on the Resources page, choose Track 1 or Track 2, and start building!

contests.title: 全新升级！第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松开启报名
contests.description:
全新升级！第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松开启报名

2026年3月，自变量发起和举办首届「具亮计划」黑客松，聚焦从数据采集、模型训练到真机部署的全链路实践。彼时，模型的能力仍受限于训练中见过的任务，想让机器人完成一项新任务，往往需要先采集对应数据，再进行针对性训练。如今，这一前提正在被打破。随着具身基础模型已经能够理解物理世界，在陌生任务上实现零样本泛化，具身智能第一次具备了像大语言模型一样可通过API直接被调用的条件。以这一技术演进为基础，2026年11月，自变量将在美国·硅谷与中国·深圳，举办第二届具亮计划·全球具身智能黑客松Embodied Agent Hackathon，本次比赛自变量将直接提供VLA和WAM具身基础模型的API，结合Agent，搭配机器人硬件，大大简化开发流程。以零样本开放世界操作为核心能力，无需任何任务适配，仅凭自然语言指令驱动，即可在全新场景中完成从任意物体抓取放置，到柔性物体操作、双臂协同与工具使用的各类任务。选手无需采集数据、无需微调模型，结合Agent即可开展任务开发，把精力真正投入到长程复杂任务的攻克上。你可以自由选择模型、组合技术、探索不同路径，用真实任务检验自己的设计和想法。从构想操作任务到机器人自主执行，期待你的方案在现场交出答卷！

contests.title: SEE Conf 2026：创造力复兴，探索 AI 时代的用户体验与工程实践
contests.description:
SEE Conf（蚂蚁终端体验科技大会）由蚂蚁终端技术委员会主办，是一场融合前沿分享、技术展台与沉浸式互动的科技盛会。

SEE Conf（蚂蚁终端体验科技大会）由蚂蚁终端技术委员会主办，是一场融合前沿分享、技术展台与沉浸式互动的科技盛会。SEE 是 Seeking Experience & Engineering 的缩写，意为探索用户体验与卓越工程实践。在这里，我们期待与业界同行共同分享和交流体验科技的最新进展，探讨切磋 AI 时代体验科技的未来发展，共同让生态繁荣共赢。
SEE Conf 2026：创造力复兴本届是 SEE Conf 的第七届，将会围绕 “创造力复兴，探索 AI时代的用户体验与工程实践” 核心主题，我们希望借助 AI，让更多人突破专业、成本与协作条件的限制，把过去难以实现的构想做出来，催生更丰富的产品、内容、服务与协作方式。“你和我”既是创造者，也是体验者，一个人的创造，也可以成为另一个人的新体验。大会亮点2026 年 11 月 28 日（周六）在杭州蚂蚁 A 空间，大会会议时长为一天，上午主会场，下午将设置 4 个分会场：AI 创新体验、卓越 AI 工程实践、AI 新交互与多端，以及 SEE Next 会场。我们相约一起，讨论如何兼顾质量、效率、成本与人的掌控，让新的创造可靠落地；同时通过开源与开放协作，让能力、方法与经验被更多人获得和共同改进。主题聚焦：「创造力复兴，探索 AI 时代的用户体验与工程实践」全程一天：32+ 场以上演讲，等你来！ 上午主会场业界大佬云集、下午四大专场平行展开：主会场，创造力复兴：以“创造力复兴” 核心主题，阐述 AI 下的一些观点和体验。AI 创新体验：关注 AI 正在催生哪些新的产品、体验与使用方式，以及这些变化如何释放人的创造力。卓越 AI 工程实践：关注 AI 如何改变软件的开发、交付与运行，以及如何把 AI 应用做得可靠、高效、可持续。AI 新交互与多端：关注 AI 时代人与系统交互方式的变化，以及支撑这些体验的终端技术。SEE Next：从技术周期来看，AI 处于发展的早期，许多可能尚是 Undefined，许多习以为常的事物也等待被 Redefine。丰富体验：现场设有 ~20 个技术展台，覆盖技术、产品、体验各个方面，带你近距离交流与产品体验。乐队表演：科技与激情双重碰撞，「996 x 万塘路 18 号 x 无共识」乐队首度联袂表演，带你 High 翻全场！门票信息购票地址：https://seeconf.antgroup.com早鸟票：99元/张（即日起到11月8日）
售完恢复原价 199元/张售票时间：即日起至 2026 年 11 月 24 日（微信扫码购票）2026 年 11 月 28 日，杭州蚂蚁 A 空间，不见不散！
